# Vendor review checklist

Version 0.1 · Prepared 2026-10-13 · Proposed operating practice pending owner adoption

Before selecting, renewing or materially changing a vendor:

- [ ] Need cannot be met safely with an existing approved tool
- [ ] Official provider identity/URL and plan scope verified
- [ ] Compare total cost including seats, storage, usage, taxes, annual commitment and exit/migration effort
- [ ] Review recurrence, cancellation/refund restrictions, price changes and data export
- [ ] Test a representative export with sample data before lock-in when feasible
- [ ] Review security/MFA/access logs, data region, backups, incidents and subprocessors
- [ ] Evaluate permissions and sensitive-data transmission; obtain specific approval
- [ ] Confirm legal terms, DPA, insurance and client obligations with reviewers where needed
- [ ] Identify single-provider/failure dependency and an exit alternative
- [ ] Record owner, renewal and cancellation decision deadline
- [ ] Discuss counterparty, costs, recurrence, terms and risks; obtain approval in principle
- [ ] Obtain separate explicit final confirmation immediately before financial execution

No free trial is presumed harmless if it auto-converts, consumes credits, requires a card, creates obligations or uploads data. Avoid installing or granting persistent access during research. Record decision and evidence even when declining the vendor.
